tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /dam chos dgongs pa gcig pa'i khog dbub sa'i don bsdus pa bzhugs so/ //srid gsum 'khor ba stongs par ma gyur tshe/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i skyab
༄༅/ /dam chos dgongs pa gcig pa'i khog dbub sa'i don bsdus pa bzhugs so/ //srid gsum 'khor ba stongs par ma gyur tshe/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i skyab

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dam chos dgongs pa gcig pa'i khog dbub sa'i don bsdus pa bzhugs so// /srid gsum 'khor ba stongs par ma gyur tshe// mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon mchog dam pa// mnyam med chos dbang rin chen chos kyi rje// dpal ldan 'bri gung gling pa la btud de// ji snyed dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi// thugs dgongs rmad byung bla med khyad 'phags pa// brgya dang dgu bcur rnam grags bzhed pa'i tshul// rin chen gsung las mdor bsdus bri bar bya// zhes mchod par brjod pa mdor bsdus nas/ da 'chad thabs gzhung nyid la nye bar 'jug par bya/ de yang bshad pa'i tshul la gdul bya'i khyad par gyi spyir bshad lugs dpag tu med pa mdzad kyang*/ da lan 'di'i skabs su/ rtsis mgo rnam pa lnga'i sgo nas 'chad par bya ste/ de yang gang zag gang gis mdzad pa dang*/ phyogs gar gtogs pa dang*/ mtshan ci la gsol ba dang*/ dgos ched ci'i phyir du mdzad pa dang*/ dbu zhabs su don bsdus ston pa dang bcas te rnam pa lnga las/ dang po ni/ rtsom pa po/ rtsa ba rdo rje'i gsung gang gis mdzad pa dang*/ 'grel pa gang gis mdzad pa'o// dang po ni/ skyob pa 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po yin la/ 'grel pa mdzad pa po yang spyan snga 'bri gung gling pa chos lnga dang ldan pa des mdzad/ de la chos ni/ lha dang bla mas gnang ba thob pa/ gnyis med kyi don khong du chud pa/ gsung rab la rang dbang thob pa/ brgyud pa gong ma'i gdams ngag dang ldan pa/ sems can la tshad med pa'i snying rje dang ldan pa dang bcas te lnga dgos pa yin la/ mtshan ni brjod bya la mtshan du gsol ba/ khyad par du 'phags pa'i chos sam/ dgongs pa gcig pa zhes bya ba'o// phyogs ni sde snod gsum char du gtogs pa yin no// dgos ched ni spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba sogs bla ma'i thugs dgongs rdzogs pa'i bar dang*/ khyad par du 'jig rten mgon po'i chos mdzod ma lus pa dar zhing rgyas pa'i phyir du mdzad/

dbu zhabs su don bsdus ston pa la yang*/ thog mar 'chad pa klad kyi don dang*/ bar du 'chad pa gzhung gi don dang*/ tha mar 'chad pa 'jug gi don dang bcas te rnam pa gsum/ dang po la yang mchod par brjod pa dang*/ bri bar dam bca' ba rnam pa gnyis/ mchod par brjod pa la yang gsum ste/ dgos pa'i don dang*/ bsdus pa'i don dang*/ tshig gi don dang bcas te rnam pa gsum/ dang po ni/ rang gi rgyud la tshogs gnyis rgya chen po rdzogs pa dang*/ bstan bcos rtsom pa mthar phyin pa'i dgos pa dang gnyis/ bsdus pa'i don ni/ gang zag gang la rtsom pa po gang gis tshul ji ltar du phyag 'tshal ba dang gsum/ gsum pa tshig gi don ni/ dri med 'od gsal gyi tshig don la 'bru snon/ des mchod par brjod pa song*/ gnyis pa brtsam par dam bca' ba la yang*/ chos gsung ba po'i che ba dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i chos thugs su chud pa po 'jig rten mgon po'i che ba dang*/ 'grel pa rtsom pos khengs pa bskyung zhing zhar la brtsam par dam bca' ba'o// des thog mar 'chad pa klad don song*/ bar du 'chad pa gzhung gi don la yang*/ mdor bsdus te lus rnam par bzhag pa gdugs spyi lta bu'i tshul gyis 'chad pa dang*/ bye brag so sor phye ste yan lag rgyas par bshad pa gdugs kyi rtsibs lta bu'i tshul du 'chad pa dang*/ de dag gi don bsdu ba chings gnad kyi man ngag nyams len 'bras bu dang bcas pa sham bu'i tshul du 'chad pa dang bcas te rnam pa gsum/ dang po lus rnam gzhag la yang*/ dbye bsdu lhan thabs kyi 'debs tshul/ yin min grub mtha'i 'gal spong*/ tshoms bdun go rim gy-i rnam dbye/ de dag chos lngar 'dus tshul/ dgongs pa gcig tshul gyi sgra bshad/ de dag spyi'i don bsdus gzhi lam 'bras bu'i sbyor so// chos bdag gang zag gi rnam par thar pa dang bcas te rnam pa brgyad/ dang por dbye bsdu lhan thabs kyi 'debs tshul la yang*/ spyir khyad chos dgongs pa gcig pa 'di la dbye na/

chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong*/ tshur bsdu na chos thams cad gshis sam babs kyi gnas tshul bya ba 'di'i nang du bsdus pa yin gsungs/ de ltar rdo rje'i gsung nyis brgya lhag cig mchis pa las/ lnga bcu lhan thabs su 'debs tshul ni/ gzhung snga ma rtsa tshig brgya lnga bcu pa/ tshoms bdun kho nar nges pas/ de rnams kyi rdo rje'i gsung sum cu rtsa bzhi'i nang du lhag ma lnga bcu po de lhan thabs su btab nas 'chad dgos pa yin la/ spyir gyis rdo rje'i gsung brgya lnga bcu po 'di rgyas par bshad na/ gzhan rnams sgrog rang brdal la 'gro ba yin pas 'debs mi dgos la/ 'on kyang 'debs par 'dod na/ dang po chos 'khor gnad bsdus kyi tshoms 'di'i nang du 'debs tshul ni/ chos thams cad kyi gshis sam babs kyi gnas tshul bya ba 'dis/ khyad chos dgongs pa gcig pa 'di'i don mtha' dag rdo rje'i gsung 'di nyid du bsdoms shing*/ bstan bcos 'di'i lus rnam par bzhag pa yin te/ 'on kyang da lan 'dir gzhi dbye ba'i ya gyal du bgrang ba dang*/ tshig de nyid kyi ngo skal gyi mtshon pa'i bshad pa zhig zur du yod pa yin pas/ tshig 'di'i nang du phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi bstan pa gcig bya ba dang*/ rgyal ba'i dgongs pa rigs gcig theg pa gcig bya ba dang*/ theg pa dang grub mtha' sangs rgyas kyi rten 'brel zhes pa 'di rnams rdo rje'i gsung gcig tu byed/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por bzhag bya ba dang*/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong sangs rgyas su sgrub pa'i thabs su gcig bya ba 'di gnyis rdo rje'i gsung gcig tu byed/ gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis re re'i nang du ci rigs par tshang bya ba dang*/ chos kyi 'khor lo re re'i nang du'ang gsum kha tshang bya ba dang 'di gnyis sdom pas rdo rje'i gsung gcig tu byed pa sogs gzhan rnams la rigs 'gre ste shes par bya'o// dbye bsdu lhan thabs kyi 'debs tshul bstan zin to//

༈ //gnyis pa yin min grub mtha'i 'gal spong la'ang*/ 'di dang 'di lta bu 'jig rten mgon pos bzhed pa yin byas tsa na/ 'ga' zhig mnyam du nyams len bya rgyu med par/ tshig mang po'i 'don rgyu gcig snyam nas/ khyed kyi grub mtha' de zer ba yod par snang ste/ 'di grub mtha' yin pa'i lugs dang*/ min pa'i lugs gnyis su yod/ grub mtha' yin lugs ltar na/ nga la khas len med pa'i phyir// nga la skyon de thal mi 'gyur// zhes dang*/ yang rgyal ba'i sras po cang mi gsungs// ma gsungs pa yang rgya cher bshad// ces dang*/ 'jig rten mgon po'i zhal nas/ dge ba dkar po dge ba'i mtshan nyid 'dzin pas/ dge ba mi dge bar 'gyur mi srid de/ dge ba gshis dge/ mi dge gshis kyi mi dge ba'i mtshan nyid 'dzin cing*/ mi dge ba dge bar 'gyur mi srid pa 'di nga'i grub mtha' chen mo yin gsungs/ mthar son yang 'gal ba med pa yin gsungs/ grub mtha' yin pa ltar na/ rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta phal dang kha ba can gyi bod yul 'dir bshad pa byed pa rnams chos ga shed thag ring po zhig tu bzhag nas 'chad pa'i skabs su'ang pha ki na zer nas grub rtsis mkhan gyi mdzub mo bzhin du thog tu mi 'bab pa'i bshad pa mang po byed pa rnams ni/ rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ma yin te/ dpal phag mo gru pa'i zhal nas/ grub mtha' blo yi mdud pa la// sangs rgyas dgongs par 'khrul ba rnams// de nyid rtogs par gyur nas kyang*// dran 'dzin rang sar dag mdzad gsol// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ lta ba thams cad gzung 'dzin gnyis su 'du// gzung dang 'dzin pa gti mug ma rig pa// zhes/ grub mtha' 'dzin pa thams cad rang rgyud ces dang*/ bden pa ni grub mtha' ji snyed pas sgrib ces pa'i tshul gyis grub mtha' ma yin gsungs/ des na snga ma grub mtha' yin ma byas sam snyam na/ ming grub mthar btags pa la 'jigs rgyu med de/ 'jig rten mgon po'i zhal nas/

pha drin can gyi dgongs pa lon lags na// rmongs pa'i tshig la 'jigs rgyu med// gsungs pas/ de ltar grub mtha' yin min gang byas kyang*/ 'gal ba med pa yin gsungs/ des yin min grub mtha'i 'gal spong song zin te/ gsum pa tshoms bdun gyi go rim gy-i rnam dbye ni/ gang nas bshad kyang 'brel chags pa yin no// bzhi pa de dag chos lngar 'dus tshul ni/ bslab pa byang chub sems kyi tshoms des rgyu'i snying po byang chub kyi sems bstan/ rig 'dzin sngags kyi gnad bsdus kyi tshoms des gsang sngags snying po yi dam bstan/ lta sgom spyod gsum tshoms kyis yon tan gyi snying po bla ma bstan/ chos 'khor spyi'i gnad bsdus tshoms dang*/ kun la phan pa rten 'brel gnad bsdus tshoms des don gyi snying po phyag rgya chen po bstan/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas sa'i gnad bsdus kyi tshoms des 'bras bu'i snying po bsngo ba bstan to// 'dul ba so so thar pa'i gnad bsdus kyi tshoms des/ de dag thams cad kyi bgegs sel dang bogs 'don/ khyad par du yi dam lha'i gegs sel dang bogs 'don bstan pa yin no// de ltar rtsa ba'i tshig nyis brgya la brten nas/ ji snyed cig gsungs pa de thams cad dam pa'i chos lnga ldan gyi lag len no// skyon spong ba dang yon tan sgrub pa la gegs sel bogs 'don gyi gnad/ mthar thug bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas bsgrub pa'i thabs gra ma chag zur ma nyams lhad ma zhugs/ nor ba dang 'khrul pa med pa/ gru bzhi logs brgyad/ rtse mo dbal dang dgur ldan pa/ sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams la bor rgyu dang 'jog rgyu skra'i rtse mo tsam yang med pa/ thams cad bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i sgrub thabs chen mo/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i thabs su gcig bya ba 'di bstan pa yin te/ de'i tshul yang*/ dam pa'i chos lnga ldan gcig bstan pa yin no//

༈ //lnga pa dgongs pa gcig tshul gyi sgra bshad ni/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad chos 'di'i steng du gsung mthun/ dbyangs mthun pas na dgongs pa gcig pa zhes bya'o// de la gnyis te/ spyi'i dgongs pa gcig pa dang*/ bye brag khyad par gyi dgongs pa gcig pa bcas te rnam pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ spyi dang bye brag med par thams cad thun mong du bstan pa yin te/ de skad du yang ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ 'jig rten khams ni stong dag tu// ngas ni mdo sde gang bshad pa// tshig 'bru tha dad don gcig pa// zhes gsungs pas/ skye med phyag rgya chen po 'di'i steng du sangs rgyas thams cad dgongs pa gcig pa de shes par gyur na/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad kyi dbye bsdu dang bye brag mi shes pa med de/ yum rgyas pa las/ rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ gzugs nas rnam mkhyen bar gyi chos gcig gi mdo dang rgyas pa shes na/ chos thams cad kyi mdo dang rgyas pa shes par 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de'i tshul yang 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir chu bo chen po bzhi/ chu g.yog lnga brgya dang bcas pa dang*/ chu bran steng kha lu ma 'bab chu sogs kha dog dang dri ro nus pa so so tha dad pa thams cad rgya mtsho chen por phyin pa'i dus su lan tshwa'i ror gcig pa de bzhin du/ sems can mos pa sna tshogs pa la dgongs nas/ chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong sogs gsung rab kyi bye brag theg pa dang*/ grub mtha'i rnam dbye sna tshogs pa gsungs kyang*/ mthar thug tshul gcig pas skye med phyag rgya chen po 'di'i steng du gzhol zhing 'bab pa yin no// chos kyi phung po brgyad khri dang*// bzhi stong gsungs pa gang yin pa// chos nyid 'di la gzhol zhing 'bab// ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro// de ltar skye med phyag rgya chen po de la dbye ba med par yin nam snyam na/ ma yin te/ gzhi phyag rgya chen po dang*/ lam phyag rgya chen po/

'bras bu phyag rgya chen po'i dbye ba'o// gnyis pa bye brag khyad par dgongs pa gcig pa ni/ snga ma de la kha tshar gcig 'debs dgos pa yin te/ de gang yin na/ rje mnyam med bzhed pas/ phyag rgya chen po stong nyid rgyu 'bras su 'byung tshul yin no// de'i tshul yang*/ thabs dang bral bas shes rab kyis kyang 'ching la/ shes rab dang bral ba'i thabs kyis 'ching bas/ des na thabs shes dbyer med stong pa nyid rgyu 'bras kyi nyams len 'di nyid du 'dus par rig par bya'o// gzhi lam 'bras bu'i sbyor so la yang*/ thabs kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems des khyad par du byas pa'i sdom gsum la sogs dkar po dge ba'i chos ma lus pa dang*/ shes rab zab mo skye med phyag rgya chen po dbyer med zung 'jug tu nyams su blangs pas/ 'bras bu skyon med cing yon tan rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gcig 'byung ste/ so sor thar pa'i sdom pas sprul sku 'byung la/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pas longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku 'byung*/ gsang sngags rig 'dzin sdom pas bde ba chen po'i sku 'byung*/ sdom pa gsum gyis rgyud bsdoms pa'i steng du/ rnal 'byor bzhi ltar nyams su blangs pas/ chos kyi sku 'byung*/ de ltar sku re re gar yod du gsum char yod pas/ sku gsum dbyer med pa ni ngo bo nyid kyi sku ste/ sku rnam pa lnga lhun gyis grub pa ni/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub ces bya ste/ phyag rgya chen po ni kun la khyab pa'i skye med de yin/ mchog ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi sku mthar thug yin/ dngos grub ni yon tan 'phrin las dang bcas pa yin/ rgyu bsod nams kyi tshogs las/ gzhan don gzugs sku rnam pa gnyis 'byung zhing*/ 'bras bu ye shes kyi tshogs las/ rang don du chos kyi sku 'byung ste/ de skad du yang dge ba 'di zhes pa'i don no// gzhi lam 'bras bu'i sbyor so bstan to// bdun pa de dag spyi'i don bsdus las yang rgyal ba thams cad kyi dgongs pa gcig pa/

khyad chos brgya lnga bcu po bya ba 'di/ chos gzhan thams cad las khyad par du 'phags pa zhig yin zhes smras tsa na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das khong rang gi thugs su chud pa'i chos da lta gsung rab kyi tshogs su 'byung ba 'di rnams thams cad kyi don las/ khyad par du 'phags pa zhig yin nam snyam na/ de ma yin te/ 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir grub thob 'ga' zhig gis nyams su myong ba dang*/ paṇ+ḍi ta 'ga' zhig gi 'dod lugs tha dad pa/ bod rgan spyi pa'i chos 'ga' zhig las/ khyad par du 'phags zhes zer ba yin/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' ni gang dang yang mi 'gal bar/ thams cad dgongs pa gcig pa 'di'i nang du gzhol zhing 'bab pa zhig bstan pa yin te/ zhal snga nas/ nged yin pa gsang sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa zhig yin/ spyod pa 'dul ba'i cho ga spyod/ mthun pa rgyal ba'i bka' dang mthun/ su'i chos la yang mi smod pas/ chos la brten pa'i g.yang sa ni med/ log shes can tshar gcod pa ni ma gtogs so// zhes gsungs pas/ thig drang por btab pa dang 'dra bar 'khor 'das kyi gshis babs ji ltar yin pa de ltar ston par byed pa la/ thig drang por btab na sgur po thams cad ras su 'gro ba dang 'dra bar mdo rgyud kyi dgongs pa ma lon pa rnams log shes can yin pas/ de dag tshar bcad pa la nyes pa med/ sangs rgyas kyi chos gang la yang*/ nang 'gal dang spong len gnyis su med par nyams su len/ nang 'gal spong len gnyis su song na bod rgan spyi pa'i chos so// des na khyad chos dgongs pa gcig pa 'di nyid tshad ma rnam pa bzhi'i khyogs kyis legs par khyogs nas bshad par bya'o// des de dag spyi'i don bsdu song zin to// ༈ //brgyad pa chos bdag gang zag gi rnam par thar pa la/ chos thugs su chud pa po 'jig rten mgon po'i rnam thar dang*/ dgongs 'grel mdzad pa po spyan snga 'bri gung gling pa'i rnam thar dang gnyis las/ dang po ni/ skyob pa 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po rin po che de/

sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon pa zhig yin te/ de'i tshul yang mdo rgyud nyi shu rtsa gcig nas lung bstan pa yin te/ nyi shu lnga pa las/ rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ dper na/ nga nyid ma 'ongs pa'i dus na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rin chen dpal zhes bya ba'i ming yongs su 'dzin pa'i sgo nas sems can rnams la chos ston pa dang*/ ched du brjod pa'ang ched du brjod do// zhes pa la sogs mdo rgyud mtha' yas pa nas lung bstan pa yin no// 'bri gung gling pa'i rnam thar ni chos lnga ldan gyi skabs su bstan zin to// 'jig rten mgon po'i rnam thar rgyas pa ni phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rnam thar dang*/ bye brag tu rnam thar rma bya ma/ mthong ba don yod/ zad mi shes pa za ma tog phyogs bcu ma la sogs rnams su blta bar bya'o// des chos bdag gang zag gi rnam thar bstan zin to// bye brag so sor phye ste yan lag rgyas par bshad pa la'ang*/ tshoms rnam pa bdun yod pa las/ dang po lta sgom spyod gsum gyi tshoms la/ rdo rje'i gsung nyi shu/ lhan thabs lnga dang nyer lnga/ 'dul ba so thar tshoms la rdo rje'i gsung nyer gsum/ lhan thabs dgu dang so gnyis/ bslab pa byang sems kyi tshoms la rdo rje'i gsung nyer bzhi/ lhan thabs drug dang sum cu/ rig 'dzin sngags kyi tshoms la rdo rje'i gsung nyer brgyad/ lhan thabs bcu bdun dang zhe lnga/ chos 'khor tshoms la rdo rje'i gsung sum cu/ lhan thabs bcu drug dang zhe drug rten 'brel tshoms la rdo rje'i gsung bco lnga/ lhan thabs gcig dang bcu drug 'bras bu'i tshoms la rdo rje'i gsung bco lnga/ lhan thabs gcig dang bcu drug de ltar brgya lnga bcu'i khongs su lhag ma nga drug lhan thabs su btab nas 'chad dgos pa yin no// des bye brag so sor phye ste yan lag rgyas par bshad pa bstan zin/ gzhan rnams ni chos brgyud pa med pa dang*/

gter ma la sogs pa zab par 'dod pa yod mod kyis/ zhes pa'i sogs khongs nas/ sa chos dang*/ shing chos dang*/ gnam chos dang*/ rdol chos la sogs pa ston pa yin la/ 'dir rdo rje'i gsung brgyud pa las brgyud pa'i chos zab cing ngo mtshar ba yin gsungs pas/ de yang lta ba rnam par dag pa dbu ma'i brgyud pa dang*/ spyod pa rnam par dag pa pha rol tu phyin pa'i brgyud pa dang*/ 'bras bu rnam par dag pa sngags kyi brgyud pa dang*/ brgyud pa 'di gsum dang ldan pa zhig yin te/ dang po ni sangs rgyas/ klu sgrub/ zla ba grags pa/ rig pa'i khu byug jo bo rje/ des 'brom ston/ des sprul sku bya yul ba/ des dwags po la gnang ba yin no// gnyis pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ byams pa/ 'phags pa thogs med/ gcung dbyig gnyen/ 'phags pa grol sde/ btsun pa grol sde/ dul ba'i sde/ grags pa'i mtshan/ seng ge bzang po/ ku sā li che chung*/ gser gling pa/ jo bo rje/ 'brom ston/ bya yul ba/ des mnyam med dwags po la brgyud pa'o// gsum pa 'bras bu sngags kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang la sogs pa/ des brgyud pa chu bo gsum 'dres bstan zin to// 'dir rdo rje'i gsung*/ brgyud pa las brgyud pa'i chos zab cing ngo mtshar zhes gsungs pas/ lta ba rnam par dag pa dbu ma'i brgyud pa yang 'dir yod/ spyod pa rnam par dag pa pha rol tu phyin pa'i brgyud pa yang 'dir yod/ 'bras bu rnam par dag pa sngags kyi brgyud pa yang 'dir yod/ des na/ zhal nas zhal du brgyud pas tshig gi zur ma chag snyan nas snyan du brgyud pas rang bzo dang snyan ngag tu ma song*/ thugs nas thugs su brgyud pas byin rlabs drod ma yal/ dngos grub kyi chu bo ma nub pa'o// des na brgyud pa chu bo gsum 'dres kyi gdams pa yin te/ lung las brgyud pa chu bo gsum 'dres pa zhes pa'i don no//
zhes dam chos dgongs pa gcig pa'i khog dbub kyi don bsdu cung zad 'di yang 'bri gung 'og min gyi gnas su/ kun dga' ming can bdag gis zin bris su bgyis pa'o /// /
